entries.name: Basic
entries.description: Picks a random move and target. The default style.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries.description: Most expected damage, favouring knockouts. Reads triggers, counting setup effects at half weight.

entries.name: Tactician
entries.description: Aggressive scoring plus the value of field setup, reactions, statuses, debuffs and swapping.

entries.name: Passive
entries.description: Goes easy: prefers heals, buffs and Rest, and when nothing is worth doing takes its weakest hit. Never swaps.

entries.name: Defensive
entries.description: Plays for survival: heals and rests earlier, weighs the damage it would take, and swaps out of danger sooner.

entries.name: Trickster
entries.description: Statuses, debuffs and field setup first; damage is secondary, but a finishing blow still counts.
